dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the widest mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform slate dark-grey median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single minute high-contrast white point at the anterior-most visible section of the head.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Pronounced longitudinal linear indentation along the central dorsal axis in the posterior region, creating a distinct shadow-casting crease.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible longitudinal linear feature or ridge on the posterior dorsal surface.
